subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun, Sep 20 shortlist | Large-cap semis rip together — thin day, 3 candidates
html_body:
Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Sunday, September 20, 2026 — Kuwait time

Thin day — 3 candidates cleared the gates

Large-cap AI/semi names ripped together Friday (COHR, AMAT, CRDO) on real, same-day catalysts confirmed live on IBKR. Small/mid-cap lane produced nothing that survived all 4 gates this run — every lead there was stale, muddied, or carried a fundamental red flag. See the cut list below; that's the honest count, not a padded one.

⚠️ Cap-size balance broke down this run

All 3 survivors are large/mega cap. The small-cap lane genuinely produced nothing real — see "Cut this run" for the specific leads that failed (PAMT's insider "buy" was muddied by an offsetting same-size sale, INDP's +184% MTD headline sits on top of a discontinued clinical pipeline, GME is stale and mainstream, T1 Energy has deteriorating fundamentals). Not a judgment call to skip small caps — nothing there cleared the bar.

🔔 Sizing flag — all three are $170-$450/share

Every candidate this run is a high-priced large-cap. Against a ~$550 account (last known cash balance from CLAUDE.md — verify current balance in portfolio.json before sizing), 15% sizing is a fraction of one share on all three. IBKR supports fractional shares on these names and portfolio-manager handles fractional entries — but confirm fractional shares are enabled on your account before placing any of these orders. Round-trip commission (~$2) is ~2.4% of an ~$82.50 position — every order plan below targets well above that.

🎯 Momentum Shortlist

~25 raw candidates surfaced across 28 web + IBKR sources. 3 cleared all 4 gates. Run stock-analyzer [TICKER] for the full deep dive before entering anything.
#1 — AMAT Applied Materials Inc ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5

Semiconductor Capital Equipment  ·  MEGA CAP

Signal: +6.28% Friday (IBKR: $417.40 → $443.61) after announcing a $5B, 10-year India R&D/supply-chain investment at SEMICON India — 1 trading day ago. UBS raised its price target to $695 the same day. Confirmed via 2+ independent sources.

Price: $443.61 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$3.84B (IBKR, 90d avg)  |  RS vs SPY: Nasdaq +0.39% same session — AMAT crushed the tape

Why it's interesting: This is a real, multi-year capex commitment (not a rumor) landing on a name that had already been flagged oversold by chip-equipment watchers going into the week. Friday's range was wide ($420-$445) and closed at the high — genuine institutional buying, not a fade.

Realistic near-term target: +5-8% over 3-6 trading days — next round-number resistance above Friday's $445 high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $427-430 — closed right at the day's high ($445); chasing Monday's open into a $443 print has poor R:R. Let it breathe first.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $428.00 · stop-limit trigger $419.00 / limit $417.50 (below Friday's low $420.00 and Thursday's pre-news close $417.40) · TP1 sell limit $450.00 · TP2 $465.00 · size ~0.19 shares ≈ $82.50 (~15% of a ~$550 account) · R:R ≈ 2.1:1
Event window: catalyst behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified
Defense check: ✅ Clear Next: analyze AMAT

Sizing note: $440+/share — requires fractional shares, confirm enabled. Commission drag ~2.4% of position; TP1 (+5.1%) clears it.
#2 — CRDO Credo Technology Group ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5

AI Data-Center Connectivity Semis  ·  LARGE CAP

Signal: +4.58% Friday (IBKR: $168.25 → $175.95) after fiscal Q1 FY27 revenue of $479.0M, up 114.7% YoY, plus Q2 guidance of $525-535M — 1 trading day ago. This is a hard earnings beat, not a narrative.

Price: $175.95 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$1.29B (IBKR, 90d avg)  |  RS vs SPY: Nasdaq +0.39% same session — clear outperformance

Why it's interesting: Post-earnings drift is the cleanest setup shape this strategy hunts — the binary event is already resolved, and a 114.7% YoY revenue beat with raised guidance is a genuine business inflection, not a one-day pop on sentiment. Friday's range was tight ($170.19-$175.98) and closed at the top.

Realistic near-term target: +6-12% over 3-8 trading days — post-earnings drift continuation.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET acceptable given the tight range, or scale in on any dip to $172-173.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $174.50 · stop-limit trigger $169.50 / limit $168.50 (below Friday's low $170.19 and Thursday's pre-earnings close $168.25) · TP1 sell limit $185.00 · TP2 $195.00 · size ~0.47 shares ≈ $82.50 (~15% of a ~$550 account) · R:R ≈ 1.75:1
Event window: catalyst behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified
Defense check: ✅ Clear Next: analyze CRDO

Sizing note: $170+/share — requires fractional shares, confirm enabled. Commission drag ~2.4% of position; TP1 (+6.0%) clears it.
#3 — COHR Coherent Corp ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5

Photonics / Optical Networking  ·  LARGE CAP

Signal: +7.33% Friday (IBKR: $295.98 → $317.69) after announcing an expanded Pluggable Optical Line System for AI datacenter networks (800G ZR/ZR+, up to 25.6 Tbps) — 1 trading day ago, plus sector-wide rotation into optical/photonics names.

Price: $317.69 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$1.96B (IBKR, 90d avg)  |  RS vs SPY: Nasdaq +0.39% same session — massive outperformance

Why it's interesting: COHR is still ~28% off its 52-week high ($440) after a sharp prior selloff, so there's real room if this bounce holds — but it's also the least "resolved" of the three (product-launch pop vs. hard earnings/capex commitments). Weakest catalyst quality of the trio, hence the #3 rank despite the biggest single-day move.

Realistic near-term target: +6-11% over 3-8 trading days — toward the pre-selloff consolidation zone.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $305-308 — closed within $0.76 of the day's high ($318.45); chasing here is the classic bad-entry-on-a-good-thesis mistake.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $307.00 · stop-limit trigger $301.50 / limit $300.50 (below Friday's low $302.11) · TP1 sell limit $325.00 · TP2 $340.00 · size ~0.27 shares ≈ $82.50 (~15% of a ~$550 account) · R:R ≈ 2.8:1
Event window: catalyst behind it ✅ Halal: ⚠️ Unverified
Defense check: ✅ Clear (today's catalyst) Next: analyze COHR

Halal flag: core business is comms/industrial/AI-datacenter photonics and today's catalyst is squarely AI-datacenter optics — but Coherent's legacy II-VI lineage has carried some minor aerospace/defense optics exposure historically. Not primary-business defense, but confirm current segment mix isn't material before entering.

Sizing note: $300+/share — requires fractional shares, confirm enabled. Commission drag ~2.4% of position; TP1 (+5.9%) clears it.

Cut this run

BE (Bloom Energy) — FADED vs IBKR: search said "soaring" on Oracle/Aligned data-center deals, but live IBKR shows -4.9% Friday, well off highs. Classic stale-narrative trap.
GLBE — rose 3.9% Thursday, but IBKR shows -0.86% Friday; no fresh signal, already fading.
INTC — PT raised to $145, but only +0.27% live; not actually moving.
DELL — up big this week and near 52w highs, but -2.94% Friday; chasing a red day under highs is a bad entry, no fresh setup.
CPRT — analyst upgrade to Outperform, but -1.05% live; no momentum to confirm it.
MTRN / AUGO / SSRM — real YTD momentum grades in materials/mining, but all flat-to-modest Friday (+0.4% / +1.5% / -0.3%); no Gate 1 signal this week.
PENG — catalyst (Goldman conference) is >5 trading days old; only +1.05% Friday.
PAMT — insider "buy" (Sept 3, already stale) is muddied by an identical-size offsetting "sale" in the same filing data — looks like an internal trust transfer, not conviction buying. Dropped as unreliable.
INDP — headline +184% MTD, but the company disclosed it discontinued its only active clinical program and is "evaluating strategic alternatives." That's a fundamental red flag under a speculative penny pump, not a real setup.
GME — insider buying cluster is over a week stale, and this is about as mainstream/CNBC-covered as a ticker gets — exactly what this skill is built to look past.
T1 Energy — EPS miss, -36.5% over 6 months, no momentum signal — wrong direction entirely.
OKLO — "criticality milestone" catalyst is from August 5, over 6 weeks stale.

🏆 Today's best setup: AMAT

A real $5B, decade-long capex commitment (not a rumor) landed the same day UBS raised its target to $695 — the highest-conviction combination this scan found: mega-cap liquidity, a resolved catalyst, and same-day analyst confirmation, all outperforming a flat tape. Invalidation: a close back below $417.40 (Thursday's pre-announcement close) — that would mean the gap fully filled and the thesis failed to hold.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Order plans are for direct GTC entry per your workflow — double-check every price against your live IBKR quote before submitting, prices move over a weekend. Verify halal compliance case-by-case before entering, especially the COHR flag above. Generated Sunday, September 20, 2026, Kuwait time.
